settings.title: App Settings
settings.restoreWarnBody:
Import updates transactions and budgets only for the date range in the file. Data outside that range on this phone stays.

Accounts: restored from the file only if this phone has no transactions yet (e.g. after reinstall). Otherwise your current accounts stay.

You’ll be asked whether to also replace reminders and the buy list.

If Premium cloud sync is on, the merged result syncs (last ~2 years in cloud).

import.title: Import transactions
import.lead: Scan bank or order messages, paste text, or attach a screenshot. Review matches before saving — nothing is added automatically.
import.leadAuto: Pulse Wallet reads your bank credit and debit SMS on this phone, matches them to rules, then lets you add them as expenses or income in one tap.
import.smsHint: Reads your inbox for the selected calendar month on this phone. Messages never leave the device.
import.smsHintAuto: Scans SMS for the selected calendar month for UPI / bank credits and debits. Nothing is saved until you confirm below.
import.smsHintThisMonth: Scans SMS from the 1st of this month through today for UPI / bank credits and debits. Nothing is saved until you confirm below.
import.smsHintPreviousMonth: Scans SMS from the full previous calendar month for UPI / bank credits and debits. Nothing is saved until you confirm below.
import.smsIos: iOS apps cannot read SMS. Automatic import is Android-only.
import.smsNeedBuild: This installed app build cannot read SMS yet.
import.smsNeedBuildDetail: Your current APK was built before SMS reading was added. Expo Go also cannot read SMS. The app must be rebuilt and reinstalled so it can open the inbox and create transactions from credit/debit messages.
import.smsNeedBuildAction: Ask for a new Android development build, install that APK, then open Import again — it will scan SMS automatically.
import.smsDenied: Pulse Wallet could not read your inbox. Open Settings → Permissions → SMS and allow it, then tap Read SMS again. If SMS is not listed there, this APK was built without SMS permission and needs a rebuild.
import.smsEmpty: No matching credit/debit SMS found for the active rules.
